{{Top|leg}}
'''Survival Day''' was the term given to the [[Standard day/Legends|days]] that [[The Broken Tusk (Reuss VIII)|The Broken Tusk]] was rented for exclusive use by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Imperial forces brought [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] to the Tusk and forced them to fight in the [[Dool Arena]], usually against various predators and creatures. Some were matched against the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxer]] [[Tull Raine]].<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>

The captives selected for Survival Day were either scheduled for execution, or had information the Empire wanted to extract from them. The only way out of fighting in the arena was to reveal their information, or win the fight. No prisoner was known to have won their combat, and prisoners who revealed their information were removed from the arena but were never heard from again.<ref name="WHSV" />

Top-ranking Imperial officials enjoyed the spectacle of Survival Day, paying huge sums of money to the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Greel]] for use of the Tusk.<ref name="WHSV" />
